summary: Source candidate for #5273, not installed/native adoption. Versioned Low/Medium/High/Unknown hardness is independent of routing safety floors. Original dispatch snapshots remain immutable; explicit revision-bound current assessments can advance the card via a new provenance record and exact old native preimage, while current-scope features are rejected as pre-dispatch calibration input. Actual provider observations and accepted launch-confirmed configuration are separate evidence levels; cards show useful launch configuration explicitly labelled when provider-effective facts remain Unknown, preserving roles and invocation identities without inventing missing ones. The optional closed LEARN extension reuses maintained migration source/artifact validation, shared writer lock, possible-send custody, item-scoped scalar groups and complete retention checks. It adds only fixed annotation fields and appends supported visible field IDs while preserving existing views and enrollment. Binding5/schema3 already tolerates additive fields; new source still requires normal publication and installed caller/native visible-field qualification. Mirrored coordinator observation instructions invoke dispatch/completion recording through existing exact-comment custody and then the supported migration route; no new timer, queue or generic native writer.
title: Additive LEARN card annotations and revision-bound evidence
